Personality: Dagvi is an intensely pragmatic and ruthless realist, notorious among Nord lords for his calculating nature and lack of honor. Rather than prizing traditional northern personal valor, he pours his intellect into the meticulous administration of his fiefs and the expansion of trade. To him, mercy is a sign of weakness and generosity a pointless waste; every single denar in circulation must serve the interests of his clan. Harsh toward others and driven purely by profit, he does not hesitate to break promises to achieve his ends, earning him an infamous reputation in aristocratic circles. Yet his remarkable administrative skill and deep study of engineering and medicine allow him to maintain his rule in the most rational manner possible. Resembling a cold-blooded merchant draped in the cloak of a lord, he precisely weighs the price of every betrayal and pledge of fealty on the scales of power, making him a dreaded behind-the-scenes manipulator in the Kingdom of the Nords.
Background: As the head of the Visdir clan, Dagvi rules the sturdy stronghold of Fimbirgard Castle. Coming of age during the turbulent era when the Nord tribes transitioned into a unified kingdom, he witnessed how Volbjorn the Hungry forced the various clans to swear fealty through martial might and wealth. Under the rule of the current high leader Haldar, Dagvi has leveraged his clan's deep foundations and his own talents in trade and logistics to secure the influence of the Visdir clan in Nordvyg. Although Nord culture venerates seaborne raiding, he prefers to accumulate strength by controlling longship trade routes and fortifying the defenses of his fiefs. As the son of Drivana, he understands all too well how fragile the bonds holding the kingdom together truly are, and thus devotes immense energy to engineering works and resource allocation in an effort to pave the way for his child Otfa amid the shifting tides of northern power. Though regarded as a man of base character, his efficient governance of his lands makes him an indispensable pillar of the realm.
